service.name: Wedding music in Colorado Springs
service.serviceType: Live music for weddings in Colorado Springs: ceremony guitarist, cocktail hour duo, band and DJ
service.description: Live wedding music in Colorado Springs and the Pikes Peak region: an acoustic or Spanish guitarist for the ceremony, an acoustic or jazz duo for cocktail hour, a band or open-format DJ for the reception, on one contract with sound included and one flat Front Range travel line.

faqs.q: Do you play weddings in Colorado Springs?
faqs.a: Yes, the whole day or any one part of it, at the fee a Denver wedding sees plus one flat travel line for the run down I-25 and back, with no mileage arithmetic and no lodging. Every size arrives with sound, setup and pack-down, a certificate of insurance and a W-9. Signet Artists books Colorado Springs weddings from Denver.

faqs.q: Can a guitarist play an outdoor ceremony in Colorado Springs?
faqs.a: Yes, and outdoors is where most Springs ceremonies happen. A guitarist needs a covered, level and dry spot of about 6 by 4 feet with power run to it, and plays the prelude, processional and recessional through a small system that carries an announcement microphone for the officiant, so the vows reach the back row. The ceremony spot and the move-indoors call are agreed before the day.

faqs.q: Is a duo enough for a Colorado Springs cocktail hour?
faqs.a: For the guest counts a resort terrace holds, yes. Two musicians play at a level guests who have just met can talk across, in a corner of about 8 by 6 feet on one circuit. The trio is the size to book when the crowd spreads across a full ballroom or the hour has dancing in it.

faqs.q: What does setup look like, and does the altitude matter?
faqs.a: Setup runs 45 to 60 minutes at these sizes, and when the ceremony and the reception are in different buildings, the second act sets up while the first is playing. The city sits at about 6,035 feet, which guests from sea level notice and musicians don't.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book wedding musicians in Colorado Springs?
faqs.a: Couples tend to book music nine to fourteen months out, after the venue and before most of the rest of the list. Tell us the date and we'll come back quickly with an answer and a price for that day.
